verdict.rationale: Maritime documents cron triggers that wake an agent on a five-field schedule and deliver a prompt on every fire. Agents can also set their own schedules ('send me a digest every weekday at 9'), which the platform syncs into real wake triggers. The docs explicitly position the platform for cron jobs, scheduled functions and background workers, with sleep/wake and an optional always-on add-on. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs fire reliably, and documentation of run monitoring/history for background automations across agent types (session logs are only shown for one harness).
